editorial.blurb: This humble Chicago-area Korean gem specializes in deeply crafted broths and hotpots that feel like they've been perfected over years, with each ingredient in perfect harmony rather than competing for attention.
editorial.insiderTip: Come during cold months when the hotpots are in season—order the spicy chicken or pork neck bone hotpot for the broth that reviewers say has just the right amount of spice without overwhelming the other flavors.
